rea.source_package_identity_note: Source checkout and npm package are independently pinned; matching version text alone does not prove source-to-package equivalence.

ghidra.native_component: Built mac_arm_64 decompiler from the same archive using make -j4 ghidra_opt ARCH_TYPE=-arch arm64 OSDIR=mac_arm_64; copied into local installation.

startup_notes: System Homebrew JDK26 stalled in macOS AWT native-library loading before Ghidra analysis. Those owned sessions were stopped and cleaned up.
A project-local checksum-verified Temurin21 runtime completed REA/Ghidra analysis. No Gatekeeper or OS security settings were changed.
Firmware-region Binwalk/Unblob adapters are Linux-only in this REA release. Existing pinned fwtool extraction plus local parsers were used for Sony containers.
Mixed ARM/Thumb CP was decoded explicitly using Capstone and the recovered load map; no ordinary-ELF or raw-ARM REA import claim is made.
